newsitem.title: USA: Daimler-Benz units file $1.0 bln shelf debt.
newsitem.headline: Daimler-Benz units file $1.0 bln shelf debt.

text.p: Three Daimler-Benz AG units filed a shelf registration on Wednesday with the Securities and Exchange Commission for up to $1.0 billion in debt securities.

Daimler-Benz North America Corp plans to sell up to $700 million, while Daimler-Benz Canada Inc and Daimler-Benz International Finance B.V. may sell up to $300 million in medium-term notes, according to the filing.
Net proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes, including loans by the units to certain of their affiliates and for repayment of debt, the filing said.
The offering will be made through J.P. Morgan & Co, Citicorp Securities Inc, CS First Boston, Deutsche Morgan Grenfell, Goldman, Sachs & Co, Merrill Lynch & Co and UBS Securities.
